decisions.reason: This shower channel remains very close to the firm's core drainage know-how and customer channels, so with its own R&D and service capabilities the firm is likely to keep refining rather than withdraw it.
The tileable floor drain fits the firm's established technical base and the ongoing demand for barrier-free, design-oriented bathrooms, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although the pump-based concept is somewhat riskier than the firm's standard passive drainage products, it builds on lessons from related products and the firm's absorptive capacity supports keeping it on the market while improvements are made.
